title: Choice card: options, Best fit, typed answer

steps.text: I want to buy running shoes under 5000 rupees. Ask me what you need to know first.

steps.expect: AT-035: card collapses as if option 2 was tapped
steps.expectJs: (()=>{const log=document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-log"]');if(!log)return false;const rows=[...log.querySelectorAll('[data-side][data-gap]')];const me=rows.filter((e)=>e.getAttribute('data-side')==='me').at(-1);const user=me?.querySelector('[data-copy="user"]');if(!me||!user||!/^\s*2\s*$/.test(user.innerText||user.textContent||''))return false;const expectedId=log.getAttribute('data-b02-choice-id');const expectedLabel=(log.getAttribute('data-b02-choice-option-2')||'').trim();if(!expectedId||!expectedLabel)return false;const at=rows.indexOf(me);if(at<1)return false;const previous=rows.slice(0,at).flatMap((r)=>[...r.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="card-choice"]')]).at(-1);if(!previous||previous.getAttribute('data-card-id')!==expectedId||previous.getAttribute('data-card-state')!=='answered')return false;const summary=previous.querySelector('[data-copy="external"]');const chosen=(summary?.innerText||summary?.textContent||'').match(/(?:→|->)\s*(.+)$/u)?.[1]?.trim()||'';return !!summary&&chosen.replace(/\s+/gu,' ')===expectedLabel.replace(/\s+/gu,' ');})()
